Step 2: 47 weeks = 47 × 7 = 329 days. Add 4 days → total subtract 333 days.  
Step 3: 1164 is a leap year (divisible by 4).  
Step 4: Subtract 333 days from 1164-11-30:  
- Back 30 days → 1164-10-31.  
- Back another 303 days:

  Jun: 30 → 180-30=150, date 1164-05-31.  
  May: 31 → 150-31=119, date 1164-04-30.  
  Apr: 30 → 119-30=89, date 1164-03-31.  
  Mar: 31 → 89-31=58, date 1164-02-29 (leap year).  
  Feb: 29 → 58-29=29, date 1164-01-31.

Days in 1164 before Nov 30: Jan 31 + Feb 29 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + Jun 30 + Jul 31 + Aug 31 + Sep 30 + Oct 31 = 305 days.  
So 333 - 305 = 28 days into previous year (1163).
